name: Higher Order Tensor (HOT) Lines
aliases: Tracking Lines in Higher Order Tensor Fields
definition: A method for tracking lines in arbitrary order tensor fields by defining a function fσ(p) on the unit sphere S2 at each position p, finding its maxima/minima/saddles, and integrating the resulting direction fields.
summary: Higher Order Tensor Lines visualize complex fiber structures by tracking local maxima of tensor spherical functions, enabling multiple directions per voxel unlike second-order methods.
